title: Shri Hanuman Chalisa
author: Goswami Tulsidas
source: Traditional public-domain text. Devanagari and transliteration checked against YogaWiki.

verses.original:
श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि ।
बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि ॥
verses.transliteration:
shrīguru charana saroja raja nija manu mukuru sudhāri |
baranauṃ raghubara bimala jasu jo dāyaku phala chāri ||
verses.english: Having cleansed the mirror of my mind with the dust of the Guru's lotus feet, I describe the pure glory of Rama, the best of the Raghu line, giver of the four fruits of life.

verses.original:
बुद्धिहीन तनु जानिके सुमिरौं पवन-कुमार ।
बल बुधि बिद्या देहु मोहिं हरहु कलेस बिकार ॥
verses.transliteration:
buddhihīna tanu jānike sumirauṃ pavana-kumāra |
bala buddhi bidyā dehu mohiṃ harahu kalesa bikāra ||
verses.english: Knowing my body and mind to be lacking in wisdom, I remember you, son of the Wind. Grant me strength, intelligence, and knowledge, and remove my suffering and faults.

verses.original:
जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुन सागर ।
जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर ॥१॥
verses.transliteration:
jaya hanumāna jñāna guna sāgara |
jaya kapīsa tihũ loka ujāgara ||1||
verses.english: Victory to Hanuman, ocean of wisdom and virtue. Victory to the lord of the vanaras, whose radiance illumines the three worlds.

verses.original:
राम दूत अतुलित बल धामा ।
अञ्जनि-पुत्र पवनसुत नामा ॥२॥
verses.transliteration:
rāma dūta atulita bala dhāmā |
añjani-putra pavanasuta nāmā ||2||
verses.english: You are Rama's messenger, the abode of incomparable strength, known as Anjani's son and the son of the Wind.

verses.original:
महाबीर बिक्रम बजरङ्गी ।
कुमति निवार सुमति के सङ्गी ॥३॥
verses.transliteration:
mahābīra bikrama bajaraṅgī |
kumati nivāra sumati ke saṅgī ||3||
verses.english: Great hero, mighty and thunderbolt-limbed, you dispel wrong understanding and stand with noble wisdom.

verses.original:
कञ्चन बरन बिराज सुबेसा ।
कानन कुण्डल कुञ्चित केसा ॥४॥
verses.transliteration:
kañchana barana birāja subesā |
kānana kuṇḍala kuñchita kesā ||4||
verses.english: Golden in complexion and splendidly dressed, you shine with earrings and curling hair.

verses.original:
हाथ बज्र औ ध्वजा बिराजै ।
कान्धे मून्ज जनेउ साजै ॥५॥
verses.transliteration:
hātha bajra au dhvajā birājai |
kāndhe mūñja janeū sājai ||5||
verses.english: In your hand shine the thunderbolt and flag, and across your shoulder rests the sacred thread of munja grass.

verses.original:
सङ्कर सुवन केसरीनन्दन ।
तेज प्रताप महा जग बन्दन ॥६॥
verses.transliteration:
saṅkara suvana kesarīnandana |
teja pratāpa mahā jaga bandana ||6||
verses.english: Child of Shankara and son of Kesari, your brilliance and majesty are revered by the whole world.

verses.original:
बिद्यावान गुनी अति चातुर ।
राम काज करिबे को आतुर ॥७॥
verses.transliteration:
bidyāvāna gunī ati chātura |
rāma kāja karibe ko ātura ||7||
verses.english: Learned, virtuous, and deeply wise, you are always eager to carry out Rama's work.

verses.original:
प्रभु चरित्र सुनिबे को रसिया ।
राम लखन सीता मन बसिया ॥८॥
verses.transliteration:
prabhu charitra sunibe ko rasiyā |
rāma lakhana sītā mana basiyā ||8||
verses.english: You delight in hearing the Lord's deeds, and Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita dwell in your heart.

verses.original:
सूक्ष्म रूप धरि सियहिं दिखावा ।
बिकट रूप धरि लङ्क जरावा ॥९॥
verses.transliteration:
sūkṣma rūpa dhari siyahiṃ dikhāvā |
bikaṭa rūpa dhari laṅka jarāvā ||9||
verses.english: Taking a subtle form, you appeared before Sita; taking a fearsome form, you burned Lanka.

verses.original:
भीम रूप धरि असुर सँहारे ।
रामचन्द्र के काज सँवारे ॥१०॥
verses.transliteration:
bhīma rūpa dhari asura saṃhāre |
rāmachandra ke kāja saṃvāre ||10||
verses.english: Taking a terrible form, you destroyed demons and completed the tasks of Ramachandra.

verses.original:
लाय सञ्जीवन लखन जियाये ।
श्रीरघुबीर हरषि उर लाये ॥११॥
verses.transliteration:
lāya sañjīvana lakhana jiyāye |
śrīraghubīra haraṣi ura lāye ||11||
verses.english: You brought the life-restoring herb and revived Lakshmana; delighted, Shri Raghuvir embraced you.

verses.original:
रघुपति कीह्नी बहुत बड़ाई ।
तुम मम प्रिय भरतहि सम भाई ॥१२॥
verses.transliteration:
raghupati kīnhī bahuta baḍāī |
tuma mama priya bharatahi sama bhāī ||12||
verses.english: Raghupati praised you greatly and said: You are as dear to me as my brother Bharata.

verses.original:
सहस बदन तुह्मारो जस गावैं ।
अस कहि श्रीपति कण्ठ लगावैं ॥१३॥
verses.transliteration:
sahasa badana tumhāro jasa gāvaiṃ |
asa kahi śrīpati kaṇṭha lagāvaiṃ ||13||
verses.english: The thousand-mouthed serpent sings your glory, said the Lord, drawing you close to his neck.

verses.original:
सनकादिक ब्रह्मादि मुनीसा ।
नारद सारद सहित अहीसा ॥१४॥
verses.transliteration:
sanakādika brahmādi munīsā |
nārada sārada sahita ahīsā ||14||
verses.english: Sanaka and the sages, Brahma and the great seers, Narada, Saraswati, and the serpent king all praise you.

verses.original:
जम कुबेर दिगपाल जहाँ ते ।
कबि कोबिद कहि सके कहाँ ते ॥१५॥
verses.transliteration:
jama kubera digapāla jahāṃ te |
kabi kobida kahi sake kahāṃ te ||15||
verses.english: Yama, Kubera, and the guardians of the directions cannot fully describe you; how then could poets and scholars do so?

verses.original:
तुम उपकार सुग्रीवहिं कीह्ना ।
राम मिलाय राज पद दीह्ना ॥१६॥
verses.transliteration:
tuma upakāra sugrīvahiṃ kīhnā |
rāma milāya rāja pada dīhnā ||16||
verses.english: You did Sugriva a great service, joining him with Rama and restoring him to the throne.

verses.original:
तुह्मरो मन्त्र बिभीषन माना ।
लङ्केस्वर भए सब जग जाना ॥१७॥
verses.transliteration:
tumharo mantra bibhīṣana mānā |
laṅkeśvara bhae saba jaga jānā ||17||
verses.english: Vibhishana accepted your counsel and became lord of Lanka; the whole world knows this.

verses.original:
जुग सहस्र जोजन पर भानु ।
लील्यो ताहि मधुर फल जानू ॥१८॥
verses.transliteration:
juga sahasra jojana para bhānu |
līlyo tāhi madhura phala jānū ||18||
verses.english: Though the sun was thousands of yojanas away, you leapt toward it, thinking it a sweet fruit.

verses.original:
प्रभु मुद्रिका मेलि मुख माहीं ।
जलधि लाँघि गये अचरज नाहीं ॥१९॥
verses.transliteration:
prabhu mudrikā meli mukha māhīṃ |
jaladhi lāṅghi gaye acharaja nāhīṃ ||19||
verses.english: Carrying the Lord's ring in your mouth, you crossed the ocean; no wonder, for such power is yours.

verses.original:
दुर्गम काज जगत के जेते ।
सुगम अनुग्रह तुह्मरे तेते ॥२०॥
verses.transliteration:
durgama kāja jagata ke jete |
sugama anugraha tumhare tete ||20||
verses.english: All difficult tasks in the world become easy through your grace.

verses.original:
राम दुआरे तुम रखवारे ।
होत न आज्ञा बिनु पैसारे ॥२१॥
verses.transliteration:
rāma duāre tuma rakhavāre |
hota na ājñā binu paisāre ||21||
verses.english: You guard Rama's doorway; none may enter without your permission.

verses.original:
सब सुख लहै तुह्मारी सरना ।
तुम रच्छक काहू को डर ना ॥२२॥
verses.transliteration:
saba sukha lahai tumhārī saranā |
tuma racchaka kāhū ko ḍara nā ||22||
verses.english: All happiness is found in your refuge; with you as protector, there is no fear.

verses.original:
आपन तेज सह्मारो आपै ।
तीनों लोक हाँक तें काँपै ॥२३॥
verses.transliteration:
āpana teja samhāro āpai |
tīnoṃ loka hāṅka teṃ kāṅpai ||23||
verses.english: Only you can restrain your own radiance; at your roar, the three worlds tremble.

verses.original:
भूत पिसाच निकट नहिं आवै ।
महाबीर जब नाम सुनावै ॥२४॥
verses.transliteration:
bhūta pisācha nikaṭa nahiṃ āvai |
mahābīra jaba nāma sunāvai ||24||
verses.english: Ghosts and harmful forces do not come near when the name of Mahavira is heard.

verses.original:
नासै रोग हरै सब पीरा ।
जपत निरन्तर हनुमत बीरा ॥२५॥
verses.transliteration:
nāsai roga harai saba pīrā |
japata nirantara hanumata bīrā ||25||
verses.english: Illness is destroyed and pain removed for those who constantly repeat the name of brave Hanuman.

verses.original:
सङ्कट तें हनुमान छुड़ावै ।
मन क्रम बचन ध्यान जो लावै ॥२६॥
verses.transliteration:
saṅkaṭa teṃ hanumāna chuḍāvai |
mana krama bachana dhyāna jo lāvai ||26||
verses.english: Hanuman frees from trouble those who bring him into thought, action, speech, and meditation.

verses.original:
सब पर राम तपस्वी राजा ।
तिन के काज सकल तुम साजा ॥२७॥
verses.transliteration:
saba para rāma tapasvī rājā |
tina ke kāja sakala tuma sājā ||27||
verses.english: Rama, the ascetic king, rules over all; you complete every one of his tasks.

verses.original:
और मनोरथ जो कोई लावै ।
सोई अमित जीवन फल पावै ॥२८॥
verses.transliteration:
aura manoratha jo koī lāvai |
soī amita jīvana phala pāvai ||28||
verses.english: Whoever brings a heartfelt wish to you receives abundant fruit in life.

verses.original:
चारों जुग परताप तुह्मारा ।
है परसिद्ध जगत उजियारा ॥२९॥
verses.transliteration:
chāroṃ juga paratāpa tumhārā |
hai parasiddha jagata ujiyārā ||29||
verses.english: Your glory shines through all four ages and is renowned throughout the world.

verses.original:
साधु सन्त के तुम रखवारे ।
असुर निकन्दन राम दुलारे ॥३०॥
verses.transliteration:
sādhu santa ke tuma rakhavāre |
asura nikandana rāma dulāre ||30||
verses.english: You protect sages and saints, destroy demons, and are beloved of Rama.

verses.original:
अष्टसिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता ।
अस बर दीन जानकी माता ॥३१॥
verses.transliteration:
aṣṭasiddhi nau nidhi ke dātā |
asa bara dīna jānakī mātā ||31||
verses.english: You can grant the eight siddhis and nine treasures; Mother Janaki gave you this blessing.

verses.original:
राम रसायन तुह्मरे पासा ।
सदा रहो रघुपति के दासा ॥३२॥
verses.transliteration:
rāma rasāyana tumhare pāsā |
sadā raho raghupati ke dāsā ||32||
verses.english: The nectar of Rama is with you; may you always remain the servant of Raghupati.

verses.original:
तुह्मरे भजन राम को पावै ।
जनम जनम के दुख बिसरावै ॥३३॥
verses.transliteration:
tumhare bhajana rāma ko pāvai |
janama janama ke dukha bisarāvai ||33||
verses.english: Through devotion to you, one reaches Rama and forgets the sorrows of many births.

verses.original:
अन्त काल रघुबर पुर जाई ।
जहाँ जन्म हरिभक्त कहाई ॥३४॥
verses.transliteration:
anta kāla raghubara pura jāī |
jahāṃ janma haribhakta kahāī ||34||
verses.english: At life's end one goes to Raghubara's abode, and in future birth is known as a devotee of Hari.

verses.original:
और देवता चित्त न धरई ।
हनुमत सेइ सर्ब सुख करई ॥३५॥
verses.transliteration:
aura devatā chitta na dharaī |
hanumata sei sarba sukha karaī ||35||
verses.english: One need not fix the mind on other deities; serving Hanuman brings every happiness.

verses.original:
सङ्कट कटै मिटै सब पीरा ।
जो सुमिरै हनुमत बलबीरा ॥३६॥
verses.transliteration:
saṅkaṭa kaṭai miṭai saba pīrā |
jo sumirai hanumata balabīrā ||36||
verses.english: Troubles are cut away and all pain erased for those who remember mighty, brave Hanuman.

verses.original:
जय जय जय हनुमान गोसाईं ।
कृपा करहु गुरुदेव की नाईं ॥३७॥
verses.transliteration:
jaya jaya jaya hanumāna gosāīṃ |
kṛpā karahu gurudeva kī nāīṃ ||37||
verses.english: Victory, victory, victory to you, Lord Hanuman. Show your grace as a revered teacher does.

verses.original:
जो सत बार पाठ कर कोई ।
छूटहि बन्दि महा सुख होई ॥३८॥
verses.transliteration:
jo sata bāra pāṭha kara koī |
chūṭahi bandi mahā sukha hoī ||38||
verses.english: Whoever recites this one hundred times is freed from bondage and receives great happiness.

verses.original:
जो यह पढ़ै हनुमान चालीसा ।
होय सिद्धि साखी गौरीसा ॥३९॥
verses.transliteration:
jo yaha paḍhai hanumāna chālīsā |
hoya siddhi sākhī gaurīsā ||39||
verses.english: Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa gains accomplishment; Shiva himself is witness.

verses.original:
तुलसीदास सदा हरि चेरा ।
कीजै नाथ हृदय महँ डेरा ॥४०॥
verses.transliteration:
tulasīdāsa sadā hari cherā |
kījai nātha hṛdaya mahaṃ ḍerā ||40||
verses.english: Tulsidas is always the servant of Hari; O Lord, make your dwelling in my heart.

verses.original:
पवनतनय सङ्कट हरन मङ्गल मूरति रूप ।
राम लखन सीता सहित हृदय बसहु सुर भूप ॥
verses.transliteration:
pavanatanaya saṅkaṭa harana maṅgala mūrati rūpa |
rāma lakhana sītā sahita hṛdaya basahu sura bhūpa ||
verses.english: Son of the Wind, remover of distress, embodiment of auspiciousness, dwell in my heart with Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita, O lord of the divine.
